title: [Medtrum Nano]: BT -> Connection timed out
symptom: The user reports Bluetooth connection timeouts with the Medtrum Nano pump, where the pump becomes unreachable and takes minutes to connect or fails to connect, requiring multiple exits from AAPS to reconnect. The issue occurs intermittently, including after bolus attempts.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify a root cause, but a fix was proposed and tested via pull request #3270, which resolved the Bluetooth issues for the original reporter.
fix: The fix was to test and use the changes from pull request #3270, which was merged into dev and resolved the Bluetooth connection timeouts for the original reporter.
evidence_quote: Can you test with https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/3270 ? Can you let it run for a couple of days and see if it fixes it? After that pls report back and send logs
